A simple stir‑fried chicken and veggie bowl works well for a busy night. Slice 1 lb chicken breast, toss with soy sauce, garlic, and ginger, then stir‑fry 5‑6 min. Add frozen broccoli, carrots, and bell pepper; cook another 4 min. Serve over instant rice or noodles, drizzle with sesame oil, and sprinkle sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Ready in ~20 minutes.
